title: Early Voting Begins Monday in District 8 Special Election
excerpt: Early voting in the special election to fill the Laredo City Council District 8 seat starts Monday, Nov. 23, at five locations in Laredo and Bruni, with Election Day set for Tuesday, Dec. 8.
content:
Early voting in the special election to fill the Laredo City Council District 8 seat begins Monday, Nov. 23, at five polling locations in Laredo and Bruni.

The seat has been vacant since Alyssa Cigarroa resigned in September to run for mayor. The two candidates on the ballot are Gabriel “Gabe” Sanchez and Victor H. Salinas.

Early voting runs Monday, Nov. 23, through Wednesday, Nov. 25, from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Polls will be closed Thursday, Nov. 26, and Friday, Nov. 27, for Thanksgiving, then reopen Monday, Nov. 30, through Tuesday, Dec. 1, from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.

Early voting locations are the Webb County Elections Office, 1110 Washington St.; Barbara Fasken Recreation Center, 15201 Cerralvo Drive; Farias Elementary, 1510 Chicago St.; J.B. Alexander High School, 3600 E. Del Mar Blvd.; and the Bruni Community Center, 209 N. Main St. in Bruni.

Election Day is Tuesday, Dec. 8, with polls open from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Election Day voting locations are Laredo College Fort McIntosh Campus, 1111 E. Washington St.; Laredo College South Campus, 5500 S. Zapata Highway; Barbara Fasken Recreation Center; J.B. Alexander High School; and the Bruni Community Center in Bruni.

Source: Webb County Elections Administration, Nov. 22, 2026.
